import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/shop/playerShop/list/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { createQuoteMarkdown, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
/** 店铺等级对应的标识 */
const LEVEL_ICON: Record<number, string> = {
  1: '☆',
  2: '★',
  3: '★★',
  4: '★★★',
  5: '★★★★★'
};

/** 共享导航 */
const SHOP_HEADER = [
  { label: '小店列表', command: '/小店' },
  { label: '我的小店', command: '/我的小店' },
  { label: '珍宝楼', command: '/珍宝楼' }
];

/**
 * 小店列表指令
 * - 指令格式：/小店 [页码]
 * - 按热度排序展示所有营业中的店铺
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const text = (e.MessageText ?? '').trim();
  const m = text.match(/小店(?:\s*(\d+))?/);
  const page = m?.[1] ? Math.max(1, Number(m[1])) : 1;

  try {
    const result = await App({ bid, page });

    if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(result.data.message);

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '修仙小店',
          content: md,
          footer: [{ label: '返回', command: '/珍宝楼' }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (result.data.data.length === 0) {
      contentMd.addText('暂无开张的小店');
      contentMd.addNewline();

      void message.send(
        FormatGui({
          isPrivate,
          bid,
          title: '修仙小店',
          header: SHOP_HEADER,
          content: contentMd,
          footer: [{ label: '坊市交易', command: '/更多 交易' }]
        })
      );

      return;
    }

    const startRank = (result.data.pagination.currentPage - 1) * 10;

    result.data.data.forEach((shop, idx) => {
      const rank = startRank + idx + 1;
      const icon = LEVEL_ICON[shop.level] ?? '☆';
      const detail = `热度：${shop.heatScore}、在售：${shop.activeListings}件、成交：${shop.totalSales}笔`;

      contentMd.addBlockquote(
        createQuoteMarkdown(
          [`【${rank}】${icon}「${shop.shopName}」`, `店主：${shop.ownerName}(${shop.levelName})`, detail],
          [{ label: '进店', command: `/逛店 ${shop.userId}` }]
        )
      );
    });

    const { currentPage, totalPages, total } = result.data.pagination;
    const footer: { label: string; command: string }[] = [{ label: '坊市交易', command: '/更多 交易' }];

    if (currentPage > 1) {
      footer.push({ label: '上一页', command: `/小店 ${currentPage - 1}` });
    }

    if (currentPage < totalPages) {
      footer.push({ label: '下一页', command: `/小店 ${currentPage + 1}` });
    }

    contentMd.addText(`第${currentPage}/${totalPages}页 共${total}家店铺`);
    contentMd.addNewline();
    contentMd.addNewline();

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '修仙小店',
        header: SHOP_HEADER,
        content: contentMd,
        footer
      })
    );
  } catch {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('获取店铺列表失败');

    void message.send(
      FormatGui({
        isPrivate,
        bid,
        title: '修仙小店',
        content: md,
        footer: [{ label: '返回', command: '/珍宝楼' }]
      })
    );
  }
});
